test_title: PYST 3: SSC GD Constable 2025 - Reasoning (Held On: 04 Feb, 2025 - Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
Seven people, G, H, I, J, K, L and M, are sitting in a row, facing north(but not necessarily in the same order) . No one sits to the right of M. Only three people sit between M and K. Only two people sit between K and H. G sits third to the left of L. J sits to the immediate right of L.

How many people sit between I and H?
solution: Given: Seven people, G, H, I, J, K, L and M, are sitting in a row, facing north. 1) No one sits to the right of M. 2) Only three people sit between M and K. 3) Only two people sit between K and H.
